label: plan12.14-q-release-gate-g2
authorization: pending: the operator's G2 release (Docker Desktop, the dedicated index Redis p1214-index-test-redis and the configured embedding artifact; no paid call is possible)
capacity: five live indexes, 96,763 records (calibration.json tree counts for the five paid snapshots); the M1 pilot held 60,000 records in 349.3 MiB, so about 563 MiB by straight line, over Task 1's 512 MiB cap; 1,024 MiB leaves about 1.8x headroom. Host 47.8 GiB, WSL2 default limit half of it. A worker the store refuses stops the run with its reason (m2b_launch.wait_indexed).
models: none in G2: the index Gateway's upstream is unroutable (127.0.0.1:9) and the rehearsal's model Gateway posts only to a loopback stub provider; m2b_launch refuses with a provider key in the environment
teardown: m2b_launch.provisioned closes every session, the index Gateway and removes the container and volume in a finally block, a failed start included
